# Punctuation: regular dashes only

- HARD USER REQUIREMENT: never use an em dash (Unicode U+2014) in agent-authored text. That includes replies, comments, commits, GitHub markdown, rules, docs, changelogs, UI copy you write, and generated files.
- Use a regular ASCII hyphen-minus (-) instead. For asides, use commas, parentheses, a colon, or a spaced hyphen: `word - word`.
- Do not use an en dash (Unicode U+2013) either. Ranges are `1-5` or `phases 1-5`, not typographic dashes.
- When you edit a file, replace em dashes and en dashes in the text you touch. Do not add new ones. Leave third-party or generated vendor files unchanged.
- Do not sneak the character in via HTML entities (`&mdash;`, `&#8212;`) or copy-paste from models that prefer em dashes.
